summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 3+4 features (World/Nightfall activities, Live Manifest Refresh, Auth/Sync). Backend: All 25 API tests passed. Frontend: All major features working correctly including new activity types, targets page, live refresh, and account sync.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog overlay intercepts clicks on 'Mark Obtained' button in some cases
ui_bugs.workaround: Button is visible and functional, overlay animation timing issue. Use force=True in Playwright or adjust z-index/animation timing.
